name: Launch Plan
footerDisclaimer: is not a launch agency, a project manager or a marketing consultant, and gives no view on the launch. Nothing here plans a launch, runs a task, sets a date, writes the messaging or decides go or no-go, and no task is moved or rewritten. Whether to launch, and when, is yours.
servicePara: The tasks are read beside the date, because every task in the plan is read against its owner, its deadline and the tasks that have to finish before it. A plan read as a checklist looks complete; it does not find the press embargo that lifts before the feature is live, or the task that three people each think someone else owns.

seo.home: One launch plan read the way the person running launch day reads it: every task checked for one owner and a date, every dependency checked for finishing before what needs it, the go/no-go criteria checked for being stated and measurable, the rollback checked for existing, and the announcement checked against what actually ships. One payment, no subscription.
seo.services: The launch plan review, priced per plan, in twenty-four steps. No view on whether or when to launch, no marketing or project management, nothing approved, nothing moved or rewritten, no packages and no retainer.
seo.service: Send one launch plan and the announcement it goes with. Every task checked for one owner and a date, every dependency checked for order, go/no-go criteria checked for being stated and measurable, the rollback checked for being planned, and every claim in the announcement checked against the scope that ships.
seo.pricing: One rate per plan at $49.99, in twenty-four steps from $49.99 to $1,199.76. No packages, no subscription, no volume discount and no surcharge.
seo.howItWorks: Write the brief with what is launching and when, attach the plan and the announcement, pay in a panel on the same page, and get findings section by section back in three business days.
seo.standards: What Launch Plan does not do: no view on whether or when to launch, no marketing, messaging or project management, no go/no-go decision, and nothing moved or rewritten.
seo.about: A launch plan is not a checklist of good intentions but the script for a day that cannot be repeated, and Launch Plan reads one the way that day needs it: tasks against owners, dates and dependencies.
seo.faq: Why the review gives no view on whether to launch, why a plan from an experienced team is still worth checking, why nothing is moved, what fails most often on the day, and what to send with the plan.
seo.resources: Notes on why a task with two owners has none, why the embargo cannot lift before the feature is live, why go/no-go needs a number, and why a launch without a rollback is a bet.
seo.terms: The terms under which Launch Plan supplies launch plan reviews, and what it does not plan, decide or rewrite.
